about: Happy Valley-Goose Bay is a town in central Labrador, Newfoundland and Labrador, on the Churchill River where it widens toward Lake Melville. It is Labrador’s largest population centre, anchored by 5 Wing Goose Bay and as a fly-in gateway to the interior. North West River and Sheshatshiu are neighbouring separate communities. About 8,000 people live in Happy Valley-Goose Bay.
